To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Web mining techniques can be used to automatically identify and group customers into segments based on their Web usage patterns and that the Web usage patterns of the segments are stable over time and can be used to predict future behavior.
• We have shown that the use of a single model to capture the browsing behavior of all the customers of a site is not sufficient for the purpose of personalization.

(1) the Web usage mining process can be used to automatically create a personalized product message for an individual customer based on his or her browsing behavior, (2) the Web usage data can be mined to identify a customer’s product preferences, and (3) the Web usage process can be used as a tool to identify customers with similar browsing behavior.
